properties.description: Flattens SigninLogs into a stable column set for triage queries. Call it as: SigninEventsBasic()
properties.query:
SigninLogs
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, UserId, IPAddress, Location, ResultType, ResultDescription, AppDisplayName, ClientAppUsed, AuthenticationRequirement, RiskLevelDuringSignIn
| extend Success = toint(ResultType) == 0
